# Open Interpreter 0.0.52

## Models

- Bundle the maintained Codex 0.156.1 tree with GPT-6 Sol, Astra, and Luna metadata.
- Advertise the embedded client compatibility version to the ChatGPT subscription backend for GPT-6 model eligibility.

## Fixes

- Package macOS binaries, helper resources, and voice runtime consistently in signed and unsigned release modes.
- Skip Windows voice code signing and signature checks when the release signing mode is unsigned, while sealing and verifying the packaged voice runtime in both modes.
- Retain the pinned Windows SDK fetch retry for transient download failures.
